# Insta Downloader (by CodeLove)

> Free online downloader for public Instagram Reels, videos, photos, and Pinterest videos and images in HD with no watermark and no login.

## Tools
- [Instagram Video & Reels Downloader](https://downloader.codelove.in/instagram): Save Instagram Reels, videos, carousels, and photos.
- [Multi-Link Instagram Downloader](https://downloader.codelove.in/instagram/multi-url): Batch extract Instagram links.
- [Pinterest Video Downloader](https://downloader.codelove.in/pinterest/video): Save Pinterest video pins in HD MP4.
- [Pinterest Image Downloader](https://downloader.codelove.in/pinterest/image): Save high-resolution Pinterest pin images.
